title: GEMglCullFace
description: specify whether front- or back-facing facets can be culled

messages.description: whether front- or back-facing facets are candidates for culling

arguments.description: whether front- or back-facing facets are candidates for culling

body: [GEMglCullFace] calls glCullFace() each time a gemlist passes through it, with the parameters set by its creation arguments and inlets. Its creation arguments also take GL constants by name; its inlets only take their values. See glCullFace in the OpenGL reference.
